compiled:
📰 General

Jesse Jackson Jr. Criticizes Obama, Biden, Clinton at Father’s Memorial •

Jesse Jackson Jr. delivered a pointed critique following eulogies at his father’s memorial service, asserting that former presidents Bill Clinton, Barack Obama, and Joe Biden lacked genuine understanding of the elder Jackson. He stated that attendees “did not know Jesse Jackson.” Jackson Jr. expressed frustration with the perceived superficiality of the tributes. The remarks followed a politically charged event marked by tributes from prominent Democratic figures.

🌍 World

China’s Foreign Minister Condemns U.S.-Iran Conflict, Signals Potential Dialogue •

During a recent briefing, China’s Foreign Minister Wang Yi expressed strong disapproval of the ongoing U.S.-Israeli war with Iran, stating it benefits no one. He emphasized the need for a resolution that avoids escalation and harm. Wang Yi also indicated a willingness to engage in discussions regarding the conflict, suggesting a potential diplomatic pathway. The briefing occurred as part of China’s annual foreign policy review, outlining its priorities for the year. Details regarding the “expected meeting” were not immediately disclosed.

🦅 US

Country Joe McDonald, Icon of Anti-War Music, Passes Away at 84 •

Country Joe McDonald, renowned for his performance at Woodstock, died at the age of 84. His rendition of “I-Feel-Like-I’m-Fixin’-to-Die Rag” before a crowd of 400,000 became a defining moment of the counterculture movement. The song, a satirical critique of the Vietnam War, resonated deeply with audiences and cemented McDonald’s status as a prominent voice of protest. He continued to perform and advocate for peace throughout his career.

💰 Business

Oil Prices Drive Dow Futures Higher Amidst Ongoing Geopolitical Tensions •

Dow Jones futures are currently anticipating a positive market reaction influenced by rising oil prices. The surge in crude oil costs is a primary factor driving investor sentiment. Simultaneously, former President Donald Trump stated that the ongoing conflict involving Iran is now more popular among his “MAGA Base” supporters. This political commentary adds another layer of complexity to market considerations today.

💻 Technology

NVIDIA’s GPU Revival Strategy Sparks Samsung’s RTX 3060 Restart Efforts •

NVIDIA is implementing a strategy to revitalize older GPUs, and Samsung Foundry is preparing to resume production of the GeForce RTX 3060. The move utilizes Samsung’s 8nm production line previously dedicated to NVIDIA’s RTX 30 series cards. This initiative addresses the ongoing global GPU shortage by leveraging existing manufacturing capacity. Initial reports suggest the restart will focus on fulfilling demand for the RTX 3060 model.

🎭 Entertainment

Prince Harry and Meghan Return to Australia Following Netflix Controversy •

Prince Harry and Meghan Markle are scheduled to embark on a tour of Australia, marking a return to the country seven years after their initial visit. A spokesperson confirmed the upcoming trip, indicating a desire to reconnect with Australia and its fans. The tour follows recent challenges related to their Netflix documentary series. Details regarding the specific dates and locations of the visit are currently being finalized. This represents a public step forward for the couple after recent media scrutiny.

🏅 Sports

Cardinals Secure Return of Cornerback Sean Murphy-Bunting with New Contract •

Cornerback Sean Murphy-Bunting will be returning to the Arizona Cardinals for the 2026 NFL season. NFL Media reports that the player has finalized a revised contract agreement with the team. The contract details indicate a guaranteed salary of $7.105 million. This move solidifies the Cardinals’ defense as they prepare for the upcoming season.

🔬 Science

Ancient Plesiosaur Fossil Reveals Unexpected Smooth Skin, Rewriting Sea Monster Images •

A recently analyzed 183-million-year-old plesiosaur fossil has challenged previous understandings of marine reptile appearance. The fossil exhibits a combination of smooth and scaly skin, a surprising discovery given long-held assumptions. Researchers utilized advanced imaging techniques to examine the fossil’s surface, revealing details previously obscured. This finding significantly updates reconstructions of plesiosaur skin and suggests a greater diversity in their physical characteristics.

🩺 Health

Top Doctor Reveals Simple Steps to Reverse Osteopenia and Boost Bone Health •

Dr. Robin Berzin, a leading physician specializing in healthy aging, has shared a strategy for reversing osteopenia, a condition characterized by low bone density. The approach involves incorporating light weightlifting, a nutrient-rich diet, and regular hormone testing. Berzin emphasizes the importance of addressing hormonal imbalances as a key factor in combating the condition. Her method focuses on proactive measures to strengthen bones and improve overall health.
